doc.name: ailiste - new builds in Cyprus
doc.instructions:
ailiste (https://ailiste.app) is a map of new builds in Cyprus: Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Nicosia and Famagusta
(Ayia Napa, Protaras and Paralimni). For each building it has our own photographs and the stage our team saw, with
the day; the developer; renders; floors, homes, bedrooms and delivery. For each district: the asking price per square
metre and for a whole home.

The tools: `search` finds anything with a name - a building, a developer, a district, a city - in any language;
`find_buildings` lists buildings by place, size, type and stage; `get_building` gives one building; `district_prices`
gives a place's prices; `get_developer` gives a company.

Every answer carries the ailiste.app link of what it describes. Prices are asking prices in adverts, not sale prices.
`seen_by_us` is the day our team stood at the building; a stage without it is what its portal lists. For a building,
`for_sale` is what its page lists for sale by size - how many offers, their asking prices and areas - and
`developer_homes` how many of the developer's own homes are still available; `location` is where the map draws it.
What the tools return is all ailiste has on a building: no floor plans, and no advert's own link or seller, which open
on its ailiste page behind a sign-in.

tools.description:
Find buildings, developers, districts and cities of Cyprus on ailiste by name, in any language
(English, Greek, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew, Chinese); a typo is forgiven. At most 8 matches, best
first, each with its ailiste page. `lang` is the language of the names and links given back.

query.description: What to look for, by its name: a building, a developer, a district or a city, in any language. A typo is forgiven.
query.title: Query

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search by name

tools.description:
List new-build projects in Cyprus that match every filter given, 10 at a time (pass `offset` to go
on). `city`, `district` and `developer` take a name in any language or an ailiste id; a
district includes its quarters. `bedrooms` keeps buildings that have homes of that size (0 = studio).
`stage`: plot, groundworks, frame, closed (walls and windows in), finished, lived_in, stalled - or
under_construction, or ready. `delivered_by` is a year. `seen_by_us` keeps the buildings our team has
stood at. Those come first in any list. Homes handed over before 2020 are not listed.

city.description: Only this city: Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Nicosia or Famagusta - its name in any language, or its ailiste id.
city.title: City

district.description: Only this district or village - its name in any language, or its ailiste id. A district includes its quarters.
district.title: District

developer.description: Only this developer's buildings - its name in any language, or its ailiste id.
developer.title: Developer

bedrooms.description: Only buildings with homes of this many bedrooms. 0 is a studio.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

stage.description: Only buildings at this stage: plot, groundworks, frame, closed (walls and windows in), finished, lived_in or stalled. under_construction is groundworks, frame or closed; ready is finished or lived_in.
stage.title: Stage

delivered_by.description: Only buildings to be handed over by the end of this year, such as 2027. A building with no delivery date is left out.
delivered_by.title: Delivered By

sea_view.description: Only buildings with a view of the sea.
sea_view.title: Sea View

seen_by_us.description: Only buildings our team has stood at, with our own photographs and the day.
seen_by_us.title: Seen By Us

offset.description: How many buildings to skip: 0 for the first 10, then the next_offset an answer gives.
offset.title: Offset

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: find_buildings
tools.title: Find new buildings

tools.description:
Everything ailiste's page says about one building, by its ailiste id or its page's address: the
developer and its site, the stage and the day we saw it, our photographs, delivery, floors, homes,
bedrooms, sizes, views, amenities, where the map draws it, the asking price it starts at, and what is
for sale in it by size - the asking prices and areas its page lists - with how many of the developer's
own homes are available. The adverts' own links and sellers are not returned.

id.description: The building's ailiste id, 8 letters and digits, or the address of its ailiste page.
id.title: Id

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: get_building
tools.title: Building details

tools.description:
Asking prices in one district or city of Cyprus for one kind of home: per square metre and for the
whole home - the median, the mean and the middle half - with the number of homes they stand on, the
day, and the city's median beside a district's. `bedrooms` 0 to 4 for apartments, 2 to 5 for houses.
They are asking prices in adverts, each home counted once - not sale prices.

place.description: The district, village or city - its name in any language, or its ailiste id.
place.title: Place

bedrooms.description: The number of bedrooms: 0 (a studio) to 4 for apartments, 2 to 5 for houses.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang

tools.title: District asking prices

A developer of new builds in Cyprus, by its name or its ailiste id: its own site, how many

id.description: The developer's name, in any language, or its ailiste id.
id.title: Id
